pop.use: an element, icon, chip or card appearing; per-item stagger accents

tick.use: counter digits rolling, progress steps, rapid list staggers

type.use: typewriter text, prompt entry, terminal beats

click.use: cursor press on a real control; the CursorController's click beat

select.use: option chosen, item selected, state toggled

notify.use: a toast/badge arriving, agent status update

success.use: task complete, deploy green, positive resolution, AI 'generated' moment

chime.use: gentle positive punctuation; brand/logo grace note

whoosh_deep.use: big/fast camera moves, full-frame tile expansions, scene-scale travel

whoosh_soft.use: light element travel, card slides, lateral pans

reverse.use: pre-roll suck-in leading INTO a cut or reveal

riser.use: tension build into a hero reveal or stat slam

impact.use: logo lock-up, headline slam, hard chapter cut

subdrop.use: weighted scene change; pairs under a cut for cinematic gravity

glitch.use: scramble-text decode, digital state change, error/edge beat
